summary: auth-otp ships filesystem/system reconnaissance and network exfiltration in lib/core.js
details: The package's lib/core.js imports fs, os, https, http, and child_process, reads os.homedir() and uses fs.existsSync to enumerate paths under the installer's home directory, and issues outbound https.request/http POST calls to a hardcoded hostname. The module also invokes Buffer.from at multiple sites in a pattern consistent with base64 decoding of embedded strings and/or encoding of collected data prior to transmission. The combination of home-directory filesystem access, OS/system information collection, child_process usage, and hardcoded outbound POSTs in a package that presents itself as an OTP/auth utility is a credential- and host-data exfiltration shape, not the behavior of an OTP generator.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
